name: Germany
languageNote: Most international Master's programmes are taught in English (IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 88+). Basic German (A1/A2) is strongly recommended for daily life and student employment.
documents: Valid Passport (valid for >= 12 months)
Recognized Bachelor's Degree Certificate and Transcripts
Certified German or English Translations of all academic records
Preliminary Review Documentation (VPD) from uni-assist (where required)
APS Certificate (mandatory for applicants from India, China, Vietnam)
Proof of English Proficiency (IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT)
Curriculum Vitae (Europass tabular format)

Motivation letter or statement of purpose, where required. A typical length is 1–2 pages, but confirm the document type, length and submission requirements on your selected programme’s official admissions page.
Academic Letters of Recommendation
Proof of Financial Resources / Blocked Account (€11,904/year in Sperrkonto)
Statutory or Recognized Private Health Insurance
visaNote: National Visa for Study Purposes (Type D). Non-EU students must provide proof of financial resources via a blocked account (Sperrkonto) with at least €11,904/year (€992/month). APS certificate required for India/China/Vietnam.

name: Ireland
languageNote: All higher education courses are delivered in English. Standard minimum entry requirement is IELTS 6.5 (no component < 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 88-90.
documents: Valid Passport
Bachelor's Degree Transcripts and Certificate (NFQ Level 8, minimum 2:1 Honours)
Official English Language Test Report (IELTS, TOEFL iBT, or PTE)
Statement of Purpose (explaining course choice and career objectives)
Two Academic or Professional Letters of Recommendation
Curriculum Vitae / Resume
Financial Evidence showing immediate access to €10,000 living funds
Private Medical Insurance
visaNote: Irish Study Visa (Stamp 2 permission). Non-EEA students must prove €10,000 living maintenance in addition to paid tuition fees. CAO is for undergraduate admissions only; all postgraduate master's applications are made directly to each university.

name: United Kingdom
languageNote: Courses taught in English. Higher tier universities demand IELTS 7.0-7.5 or TOEFL iBT 100-110 for postgraduate computing degrees.
documents: Valid Passport
Official Academic Transcripts (UK 2:1 Honours or international equivalent)
Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from sponsoring university
Proof of English Language Competence (IELTS Academic / UKVI IELTS or TOEFL)
Statement of Purpose / Personal Statement
Two Academic References on institutional letterhead
Curriculum Vitae
Bank Statements showing required tuition and maintenance held for 28 consecutive days
Tuberculosis (TB) Test Certificate (if applicable)
visaNote: Student Visa (Points-based system: 50 pts CAS, 10 pts maintenance, 10 pts English). Maintenance requirement: £1,334/month for London, £1,023/month outside London (up to 9 months). Applications made directly to universities.
